verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents a per-project MCP server that gives AI coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code and VS Code Copilot a live connection to the project's API spec and documentation. Its MCP Metrics page logs every tool call an agent makes, including the query or endpoint behind each call, which implies a search-style tool over the published docs. Missing for 10: an explicit list of the server's tools confirming separate search and page-content retrieval, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.
